meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 自动识别你提供的来源类型（网址、GitHub 仓库、PDF 等），并抓取、转换、增强、打包成 AI 技能，还可按要求导出到向量数据库。
howto.when: 当你想从文档、GitHub 仓库、PDF 等来源创建 AI 技能，或想把文档转成适合大模型使用的格式时。

say.text: 把这个 GitHub 仓库变成 AI 技能。
say.note: 自动检测仓库并抓取生成技能。

say.text: 用这份 PDF 做一个技能。
把这个技能导出到向量数据库。
say.note: 触发导出到指定向量库。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude detect the source type (URL, GitHub repo, PDF, video, etc.) and use Skill Seekers to scrape, convert, enhance, and package sources into AI skills, optionally exporting to vector DBs.
howto.when_en: When you want to create an AI skill from sources like documentation, GitHub repos, or PDFs, or convert documentation into a format suitable for LLM consumption.

say_en.text: Turn this GitHub repo into an AI skill.
say_en.note: Detects the repo and scrapes it.

say_en.text: Make a skill from this PDF.
say_en.note: Recognizes the PDF and converts it.

say_en.text: Export this skill to a vector database.
say_en.note: Triggers export to the chosen vector DB.
